evidence.commerce_flow_review: berberine CTAs -> /berberine-checkout/?forceBundleId=plan|one (both offer blocks in sync) -> success /berberine-offer/ -> accept and decline /berberine-thank-you/. Upsell: hero-5 package + BERBERINE45 voucher ($29.97), no countdown, no ratings. Receipt binds order.*. Storefront routes go to the sales page with the query string.

issues.message: The campaign cannot be created: the store has no payment gateway (gateway group 1 lists no currency). Live SDK checks (prices, card fields, wallets, selector interaction) wait on it.
Both offer blocks shared one radio group, so the top offer loaded unselected; fixed with one group per block, gated.
Images with width/height attributes rendered at the attribute height (stretched); fixed with img{height:auto}, verified on 390 and 1280.

commands: node qa.cjs (Playwright: 4 pages x 1280/390, lazy images forced, fonts, overflow, broken visible images, console errors)
node imgratio.cjs (every visible sales image at its natural aspect ratio, 390 and 1280)
node radio.cjs (offer radios pre-selected, both blocks in sync, CTAs carry forceBundleId and the query string)
residue + brand-bleed + GLP-1/weight-loss claim scan of _site/berberine (python)
